# aeneid-044 — new house renderings

No new house renderings.

For the reviewer (not proposed as house renderings): the best-known line of the part, VI.460 *invitus, regina, tuo de litore cessi*, was built from the Latin alone:
- `l`: "unwilling, queen, from your shore I departed."
- `i`: "it was not by my own choice, my queen, that I parted from your shore."

Reviewer, 2026-11-11: the drafter's `i`, "it was against my will, my queen, that I went from your shores", carried "against my will, my queen", a run of words found in the best-known modern versions, and was rephrased to the line above. `l` is the literal word order and is kept. Neither line is proposed as a house rendering.
